card.name: Apostrophes inside transliterated names
card.fires_on: An apostrophe or opening single quote that sits inside a transliterated foreign name, such as Arabic, Persian or Italian names. It stands for a glottal stop or an elision, as in Bahá'í, Isma‘il or de' Medici.
